title: aglaonema schottianum var. genuinum
intro: Aglaonema schottianum var. genuinum, commonly known as the miniature Aglaonema or the dwarf Aglaonema, is a variety of flowering plant in the family Arum. This plant is known for its unique, attractive leaves and its air-purifying properties, which make it a popular choice for indoor spaces. The health benefits of Aglaonema schottianum var. genuinum include its ability to remove air pollutants such as formaldehyde, benzene, and trichloroethylene, promoting a healthier indoor environment. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
